component.name: WeatherWidget
component.summary: Live weather and world clocks on your desktop

description.p: WeatherWidget puts live weather and world clocks on your desktop — a compact, transparent overlay that stays on top of your windows so you never lose sight of conditions in the places that matter.

Monitor multiple cities at a glance. See temperature, humidity, wind speed and direction, weather conditions, and local time — all updating in real time. The widget is borderless, always-on-top, and adjustable in transparency so it blends naturally with your workflow.

ul.li: Live weather for several cities displayed side by side
Real-time clocks showing each city's local time and date
Enhanced and Simple views with selectable data fields
Temperature, description, humidity, wind speed and direction, gusts
Dew point, pressure, UV index, pollution and Air Quality Index
Snap to any screen corner or drag to a custom position
Celsius or Fahrenheit, plus km/h, mph or knots for wind

description.p: Flatpak fixes: reliable startup on Wayland, persistent settings and window position, and packaging documentation updates.
Maintenance release with fixes and refinements to the multi-view desktop widget.
Expanded to 12 languages with native font support, including Tamil, Japanese and Simplified Chinese, plus full UI and tray menu localization.
